name: s81sl_xr3-s81sl_xr3-COMMIT
purpose: S81 C3 control-plane sub-leaf ot_s81sl_xr3 (HB 1: band port B, S81-SMWIRE SO assembler) -- first hardened view; SAFE item 3 fix on the SO lo/hi capture enables (KEPT copies 64+64).

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_s81sl_xr3 #(.FOREG(1)) u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/lib/ot_rst_relay.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_dv/slice/ot_s81sl_xr.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/s81sl_xr3/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/s81sl_xr3/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/s81sl_xr3 --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_s81sl_xr3  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: ROOT4-S81POST 10-19: FIRST xr3 kit (no earlier xr3 route). C3 variant of the closed xr1 (s81sl_xr1f-12b616b54; same XR2..XR7 structure, FOREG 1) plus the band port B: bi input flops, the bo 513-b {pk, valid} register, and the S81-SMWIRE SO assembler (main 0408184bd). SAFE checklist: 1 pins PASS (source-registered: every input a flop at the pin, every output a flop; reset_landing 2 stages); 2 reach PASS (pin flops anchored at the faces by io_flop_at_pins, 16 regional clock roots km16; longest flop->flop span is inside a 570 x 395 tile with registered classify stage); 3 fanout FIXED: the SO lo/hi capture enables (b_so && so_n == 0 / 1, 512 loads each) are now KEPT registered copies one per 8 bits (sol_c / soh_c 64 + 64) over a staged word so_w (verified: flow keep hook ot_keep_regs.tcl keeps 64/64 + 64/64 on the paramod, sos_r 69, cis_c 69); the SO ci select sos_c is a kept copy per 16 bits; every XR5 kept copy as xr1; 4 depth PASS (as xr1; SO beat select is a registered one-hot); 5 storage PASS (no runtime-indexed flop arrays; so_lo / so_hi / so_w are 512-b registers, not delay lines); 6 floorplan waived-with-reason (pin-bound, util ~7%, see outline_why; no macros; aspect 1.44); 7 clock PASS (km16 regional roots, pin-flop spread checked by the --cts gate, io_hold_margin 0.03); 8 schedule PASS (static; the enable fix adds 0 cycles: lo / hi are captured one edge after their B word and both are valid in the so_go cycle as before).
